question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class expanded composer modal to the Control UI, or solve long-prompt friction through inline composer growth and shortcut preferences instead?
rationale: This is new user-facing UX, not a broken existing contract, and the modal would define new draft, keyboard, focus, and send semantics in the core composer.

options.title: Approve modal workflow
options.body: Design and implement an expanded Control UI composer with explicit Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus, attachments, and keyboard semantics.

options.title: Prefer inline ergonomics
options.body: Use auto-grow, send-shortcut, or resizable composer work to improve long prompts without adding a modal mode.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Reject the expanded modal if maintainers want to keep the composer surface lean.

recommendation.title: Approve modal workflow
recommendation.body: Design and implement an expanded Control UI composer with explicit Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus, attachments, and keyboard semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of prior issue review and Control UI chat history in the checked-out repository.
